correctness.rationale: The 18 bidirected prism arcs (on 6 vertices and 9 undirected edges) were generated from the actual frozen graph; exhaustive independent testing of all 2^18 subsets found 687 faces including empty and f=(18,108,260,240,60). The pivot Morse matching was independently verified acyclic on 686 nonempty cells / 2256 covers, with 326 pairs and critical counts (1 in dimension0, 5 in dimension2, 22 in dimension3, 6 in dimension4). Exact integer Morse boundary elimination gave zero differentials in every degree, consistent with independent GF2 boundary ranks (17,91,164,54). Crucially, independently derived integral two-cocycles and exact rational Gaussian elimination checked all 25 ordered Alexander–Whitney degree-two cup products as coboundaries; six raw cup cochains nonzero, so not vacuous. H4 is torsion free and hence their rational vanishing is integral. Hilton–Milnor pi3 decomposition and vanishing attaching degrees/cup quadratic terms rule out hidden Hopf/Whitehead attachments, proving the full wedge 5 S2 ∨22 S3 ∨6 S4, not just Betti counts.
